line: I walked out alone four hours ago, to prove myself to Helstrom's Agaceph.
I wanted to walk home on my own feet.
The viper is dead and you are here. I cannot say no. I will come, but I do not thank you.
Walk ahead of me. I do not want to be seen coming home like this.
